title: Tranquil Tale
description: Adventure not hard modpack for Fabric 1.21.1 | Still in Alpha
body:
![Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/91896fca6bce7235f6c27b47a9c589845888d41a_0.webp)

# Alpha 

> Modpack  in the **early stages** of development _(in a way, it's still at the idea stage)_ and it's going to stay that way until something solid comes out  

# Features
- **🏰Dungeons & Structures** - adventure and exploration around the world
- **🖼️Seasons** - there is a suitable time of year for planting for each crop, keep this in mind when you start planting
- **❤️Origins** - choose an Origin and begin your game with special abilities, some of which help you out, while others hinder you in your gameplay 
-  **👥Multiplayer** - modpack is aimed at having fun with friends, so playing in multiplayer is recommended, but not required
- **🔨Modular equipment** - create your own unique weapons, tools and armor
- **🏮Furniture and decoration** - many ways to create your own unique interior and outerior
- **🍱Cooking** - huge amount of food and drinks for every taste, from cookies to whole dishes
- **🍀QoL mods** - sorting inventory,

> _The description will be updated as it develops._
